name: telegram-readonly-mcp
description: Read Telegram cloud chats, groups and channels through a guarded local MTProto MCP. User-only interactive authorization.

interface.shortDescription: Read and search Telegram when you ask.
interface.longDescription: Seven read-only tools for dialogs, history, messages, search, unread, latest and date ranges. Local session storage and ACL. Never sends, changes, deletes or marks messages read. Requires user authorization in a local terminal.
defaultPrompt: Use Telegram Read-only to list my chats.
Read unread messages and summarize tasks for me.
Search my Telegram chats for the requested topic.
